  • Assist in monitoring headcount, onboarding flow, and site KPIs.

POR DENTRO DO ROLDÃO ATACADISTA

O Roldão Atacadista não é apenas uma empresa – é uma história de crescimento e transformação que vem sendo escrita há 24 anos. Tudo começou com a ideia de ser mais do que um atacadista. Nosso objetivo sempre foi ser um parceiro estratégico, abastecendo micros, pequenas e grandes empresas e levando soluções também para as casas dos nossos consumidores finais.

Essa trajetória só foi possível porque acreditamos no poder da nossa gente. Somos 4.800 colaboradores que não apenas trabalham aqui – eles constroem o Roldão todos os dias. Por isso, investimos na capacitação de cada um deles, acreditando que um time forte e preparado é o segredo para enfrentar os desafios do mercado e criar inovações que nos destacam.

Hoje, com 39 lojas espalhadas pelo estado de São Paulo, vivemos um momento de intensa expansão. E, para crescer, não olhamos apenas para fora, mas também para dentro. title: Lead Video Editor
description:
Transform raw footage into content that helps real estate agents win in their local markets

About Knwn Local

We're a creative agency on a mission: scale from 55 to 200+ YouTube channels while helping real estate agents become the most trusted voices in their markets. We build long-form video strategies that create real authority and drive actual business results.

The proof is in our growth:

  • Scaling fast from 55 to 200+ channels
  • Building systematic production operations that work at scale
  • Helping agents win deals through strategic content, not viral gimmicks

We believe in extreme ownership, proactive curiosity, and beyond excellence. If that resonates, you'll thrive here.

We're hiring a Lead Editor to deliver high-quality edits consistently and help us maintain our quality standards across the team as we scale.

As a Lead Editor at Knwn Local, you'll build and develop a team of video editors who transform raw real estate content into high-impact YouTube videos that help agents dominate their local markets. This is a player-coach leadership role where you'll spend 70-90% of your time managing, mentoring, and building systems, and 10-30% hands-on editing complex projects.

You’ll own editing quality standards, team development, and operational excellence within your pod, partnering closely with Pod Managers, YouTube Managers, and Strategists to deliver retention-driven content at scale. Your success is measured not by how many videos you edit, but by how well your team performs, grows, and retains talent.

This role is perfect for someone who loves developing editors as much as editing itself and gets energized by building systems, coaching talent, and multiplying their impact through others. If you want to stay purely hands‑on without management responsibilities, or purely hands‑off without getting in the weeds of editing, this isn't the right fit.

Team Leadership & Development (50% of role)

  • Manage and develop 25-50 video editors, conducting weekly 1-on-1s focused on skill progression and performance (with the support of multiple Senior Editors & YouTube Managers)
  • Lead weekly team edit reviews with constructive feedback and best practice sharing
  • Lead monthly team trainings for the editing team culture & growth
  • Build comprehensive onboarding programs and training materials for new editor hires
  • Create career development pathways with clear promotion criteria for your team
  • Conduct performance reviews and manage accountability through the Clarify Instrument Coach Decide framework
  • Participate in hiring (screening portfolios, conducting interviews, making hiring recommendations)
  • Build 2-5+ year relationships with editors through proactive retention and engagement strategies
  • Implement skip-level check-ins to assess team health and identify early warning signs

Quality Standards & Systems (20-30% of role)

  • Own and evolve editing quality standards, style guides, and templates across your team
  • Establish QA processes that maintain >85% First-Approval Rate across all editors
  • Serve as final quality review and approval for complex or high-stakes edits before client delivery
  • Lead A/B testing strategy and retention analysis, translating data into actionable editing improvements
  • Create efficiency systems (templates, motion graphics libraries, workflow optimizations)
  • Build performance dashboards tracking team metrics (approval rates, turnaround times, retention performance)
  • Drive continuous improvement through weekly "edit of the week" reviews and retrospectives

Strategic Collaboration (10-15% of role)

  • Partner with Pod Manager and YouTube Managers on content strategy and creative direction
  • Participate in Monthly Client Strategy Calls to present editing approach and performance insights
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with scriptwriters and designers to align on creative vision
  • Communicate proactively with leadership on team capacity, blockers, and resource needs
  • Contribute to quarterly planning and annual strategy with editing function perspective
  • Handle client escalations and quality issues with transparency and solutions-focused approach

Player-Coach Editing (10-20% of role)

  • Edit 2-4 high-complexity videos per month for VIP clients or training demonstrations
  • Model excellence by staying hands‑on with the craft and maintaining YouTube editing fluency
  • Stay current on YouTube editing trends, competitor content, and platform algorithm changes
  • Experiment with new techniques and tools, sharing learnings and innovations with the team
  • Maintain organized project files and asset management as an example for the team

Requirements

We're looking for someone who combines exceptional editing craft with proven leadership ability. You should be passionate about developing talent and building systems that multiply impact across a team, not just delivering great edits yourself.

Leadership & Management Experience

  • 5-7+ years of professional video editing experience with 2+ years managing or leading editors
  • Proven track record developing and scaling editing teams of 4+ people
  • Experience hiring editors (screening portfolios, conducting interviews, making hiring decisions)
  • Demonstrated ability to give feedback that accelerates growth and elevates work quality
  • History of conducting performance reviews and managing accountability (including difficult conversations)
  • Experience building onboarding programs, training materials, and documented workflows
  • Comfortable with the full people management cycle: hiring, coaching, performance management, and when necessary, firing

Technical Mastery (You Can Teach Others)

  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro – you can troubleshoot complex technical issues and teach advanced techniques
  • Strong proficiency in After Effects for motion graphics and visual effects
  • Working knowledge of DaVinci Resolve, Blender, or other tools (or quick learner)
  • Deep understanding of YouTube retention, pacing, storytelling, and algorithm optimization
  • Ability to QA others' work and identify issues across editing style, technical execution, and brand consistency
  • Portfolio showcasing both your own work AND examples of team development

Systems & Process Thinking

  • Experience building scalable editing workflows, style guides, and template systems
  • Understanding of capacity planning and resource allocation for editing teams
  • Ability to create performance dashboards and track team metrics (approval rates, turnaround times, retention)
  • Skilled at documentation – SOPs, training materials, and knowledge management
  • Process optimization mindset – constantly looking for ways to improve efficiency without sacrificing quality
  • Experience with project management tools (Asana, Notion, Frame.io) and team collaboration systems

Strategic & Business Acumen

  • Ability to translate business objectives into editing strategy and creative direction
  • Comfortable presenting to clients and defending creative decisions with data and performance insights
  • Understanding of editing team economics (capacity planning, turnaround times, quality vs. speed tradeoffs)
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with strategists, writers, designers, and YouTube managers
  • Can navigate ambiguity and make decisions with incomplete information
  • Thinks beyond individual edits to how editing impacts channel growth and client business results

Communication & Influence

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication for feedback, presentations, and team documentation
  • Ability to give direct, constructive feedback that motivates rather than demoralizes
  • Skilled at managing up (keeping leadership informed), across (collaborating with peers), and down (developing direct reports)
  • Proactive communication style – you flag capacity issues, quality concerns, and team challenges before they become crises
  • Comfortable with difficult conversations (performance issues, client escalations, conflict resolution)
  • Can translate technical editing concepts into language that non-editors understand

Work Style & Mindset

  • Player-coach mentality – willing to stay hands-on with editing (10-20% of time) while primarily focusing on team leadership
  • Excellent organizational skills managing both your own work and your team's project pipeline
  • Ability to balance competing priorities: team development, quality standards, client deadlines, and strategic initiatives
  • Comfortable context-switching between hands-on editing, team coaching, client calls, and strategic planning
  • Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments where processes are constantly evolving
  • Gets energized by developing talent and seeing team members succeed
  • Extreme Ownership – Takes full accountability for team results; models this for direct reports
  • Beyond Excellence – Sets impossibly high standards and inspires team to consistently exceed them
  • Proactive Curiosity – Anticipates problems, asks better questions, and stays ahead of issues
  • Mission Focus – Obsesses about client success and team development, not personal recognition

Results You'll Drive

Team Performance

  • Your editing team consistently maintains >85% First-Approval Rate across all editors
  • Editor retention rate exceeds 85% annually with clear development and career progression
  • New editors productive at 80% capacity within 60 days through your training systems
  • 100% of direct reports show measurable skill improvement quarter-over-quarter
  • Team operates at 80-90% capacity utilization – productive output without burnout

Quality & Systems

  • Zero client escalations due to editing quality issues or missed deadlines from your team
  • 95%+ on-time delivery rate across your entire team's project portfolio
  • Editing workflows, templates, and style guides documented and adopted agency-wide
  • Average video retention improves 5-10% year-over-year through data-driven editing strategies

Strategic Impact

  • Editing function viewed as strategic partner by Pod Managers and leadership
  • Successfully contribute to client strategy with editing insights that drive performance
  • Your team supports clients publishing 4+ videos per month consistently
  • Client satisfaction scores remain >4.5/5 for editing quality and communication
  • At least 1-2 editors promoted or advancement-ready annually due to your mentorship
  • Edit 2-4 high-complexity videos per week as benchmarks and training examples
  • Your edits consistently achieve 8-10% average retention (above platform benchmarks)
  • Model extreme ownership, excellence, and proactive curiosity through your work

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

Salary:

$36,000 - $60,000 USD annually (based on experience and team size managed)

What We Offer:

  • Fully Remote
  • Flexible Time Off policy (we trust you to manage your time and energy)
  • Access to industry-leading tools, plugins, and AI-assisted editing software
  • Opportunities to earn Monthly wellness allowance, Home office stipend, Professional development budget &/or Health Insurance Reimbursement (after 60-90 day trial period)
  • Clear career progression with transparent promotion criteria

REAL TALK:

This is an early-stage startup scaling rapidly. You'll face challenges – processes break, priorities shift, and things get messy. We need people who are resilient, resourceful, and committed long-term.

But if you want to:

  • Build a world-class editing team and multiply your impact 10x
  • Develop editors and watch them grow beyond their potential
  • Help America's top real estate leaders dominate their local markets
  • Build something meaningful from 55 to 200+ channels

This is the place.

This role is player-coach (10-25% hands-on editing, 75%+ leadership). If you want to focus purely on editing without managing people, this isn't the right fit.

Location

Remote-first

Our Core Values

  • Extreme Ownership – Take responsibility for your work and outcomes. No excuses, just solutions.
  • Beyond Excellence – Care about the details. Deliver work that exceeds expectations.
  • Proactive Curiosity – Don't wait to be told. Ask questions, identify problems, suggest solutions.
  • Mission Focus – Remember: your edits help real estate agents build their businesses. That matters.

We primarily look at those who apply above.

Pay $36K - $60K+ USD a year (depending on experience)

title: Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais - Banco de Talentos
description:
Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais - Banco de Talentos

Somos a Kaizen - A Casa da Autopeça, uma das bandeiras do Grupo Bueno - um grupo formado por empresas diferentes com um propósito comum.

Atualmente, o Grupo Bueno é composto por quatro bandeiras:

- Pecista: Focada exclusivamente em vendas de grandes volumes no atacado;

- Kaizen - A Casa da Autopeça: Um atacarejo focado em venda para mecânicos e consumidores finais;

- G10: Marca de autopeças com foco em elétrica e químicos;

- Portal: Uma solução de e-commerce para mecânicos.

O Grupo Bueno nasceu em 1994 com a Pecista, a maior distribuidora de autopeças do Distrito Federal.

A partir de 2019, iniciamos nossa expansão com a Kaizen - A Casa da Autopeça , criada para aumentar a proximidade com as oficinas e atender a pessoa física.

Atualmente, a Kaizen possui seis filiais: Asa Norte, Ceilândia, Gama, SOF Sul, Planaltina-DF e Goiânia-GO.

E não vamos parar por ai! Brasília foi apenas o começo e em 2025 vamos cruzar mais uma barreira e seguir rumo ao Brasil!

Mas essa é só a largada. Queremos ir ainda mais longe, e para isso, estamos formando nossoBanco de Talentos para Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais !

O que é o nosso Banco de Talentos?

É uma forma de você se conectar com a Kaizen e o Grupo Bueno, mesmo que ainda não tenhamos uma vaga aberta no momento que se encaixe no seu perfil. Ao se cadastrar, seu perfil ficará registrado no nosso banco para futuras oportunidades.

Transparência é fundamental:

  • Esta inscrição não é para uma vaga imediata ou efetiva;
  • Nosso Banco de Talentos é um canal para anteciparmos o contato com profissionais incríveis e nos prepararmos para futuras oportunidades;
  • Caso seu perfil se encaixe em alguma oportunidade, entraremos em contato!

Queremos ter você conosco para fazermoshistória juntos !

Responsabilidades e Benefícios

  • Será responsável por executar serviços gerais de limpeza e conservação das salas;
  • Higienização dos banheiros;
  • Realizar serviços de copa;
  • Utilização de produtos de limpeza;
  • Fazer café e distribuir nas salas;
  • Entre outras atividades correlatas.
  • Preferencialmente experiência anterior de pelo menos 06 meses;
  • Conhecimento dos materiais de limpeza em geral;
  • 44h semanais;
  • Segunda à sexta 07h às 17h, com sábado por escala em horário reduzido.
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Seguro de vida em grupo;
  • Desconto em peças;

  • Convênio com SESC;
  • Programa de indicação;

Seja bem vindo(a) à Kaizen, a sua casa da autopeça!

title: Prefeitura abre credenciamento para selecionar artistas do “Natal Encantado Dourados”
description:
Prefeitura abre credenciamento para selecionar artistas do “Natal Encantado Dourados”

A Prefeitura de Dourados publicou o Edital de Credenciamento nº 003/2025 para selecionar artistas que farão parte da programação do “Natal Encantado Dourados”, que será realizado de 1º a 30 de dezembro de 2025 na Praça Antônio João. A iniciativa integra o planejamento do município para transformar a festa natalina em um grande evento cultural, com ações coordenadas entre diversas secretarias, conforme orientação do prefeito Marçal Filho. A secretária municipal de Cultura, Gisella Melo, destacou que o trabalho conjunto busca oferecer à população a melhor celebração natalina já realizada na cidade.

O credenciamento contempla apresentações musicais, performances e intervenções culturais, com atividades concentradas especialmente entre os dias 19 e 23 de dezembro. Podem participar artistas solo, duplas, grupos ou bandas com pelo menos um ano de atuação comprovada por portfólio. O edital prevê a seleção de dez propostas, com criação de cadastro reserva, e remuneração entre R$ 2 mil e R$ 5 mil, conforme análise das propostas e possibilidade de negociação entre as partes.

As inscrições estarão abertas a partir desta quinta-feira (13) e seguem até 24 de novembro, exclusivamente pelo formulário disponível no link , sendo permitido apenas um cadastro por proponente, que deve constar na ficha técnica da apresentação. Para validar a inscrição, é necessário preencher todo o formulário e anexar um vídeo caseiro da apresentação, informações gerais com foto de divulgação e rider técnico detalhando as necessidades de som, luz e a informação sobre a presença ou não de técnico próprio.

Segundo o edital, a inscrição implica aceitação integral das regras, incluindo responsabilidade sobre direitos autorais. As apresentações seguirão a programação definida pela Secretaria Municipal de Cultura e as alterações na equipe só poderão ser feitas com justificativa e autorização prévia. Caso não haja propostas compatíveis com o interesse do evento, a organização poderá convidar diretamente artistas que atendam aos requisitos. Dúvidas podem ser esclarecidas presencialmente na Secretaria Municipal de Cultura, de segunda a sexta-feira, das 8h às 13h.

Inscreva-se e receba as notícias do dia no seu e-mail!

title: Professor(a) de Matemática (em Inglês) - Fundamental 2 e Ensino Médio - Recife/PE
description:
Professor(a) de Matemática (em Inglês) - Fundamental 2 e Ensino Médio - Recife/PE

Localização: Recife, BR

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Here nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Professor(a) de Matemática para o Fundamental 2 e Ensino Médio. Deve ser uma pessoa com paixão por educação e pelo universo dinâmico da escola, que tenha experiência em escola regular ou bilíngue com planejamento e execução de aulas dessa disciplina.

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas de Matemática alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em Matemática;
  • Experiência com Fundamental 2 e Ensino Médio;
  • Inglês fluente para ministrar aulas nesse idioma.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída;

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. title: Financial Business Analyst / Quality Assurance (Brazil)
description:
Introduction

Welcome to Gallagher - a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Whether you join us in a client-facing role or as part of our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and be part of something bigger. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way.

Overview

Gallagher is a global leader in insurance, risk management and consulting services. We help businesses grow, communities thrive and people prosper. We live a culture defined by The Gallagher Way, our set of shared values and guiding tenets. A culture driven by our people, over 50,000 strong, serving our clients with customized solutions that will protect them and fuel their futures.

We are seeking a senior Business Analyst / Quality Assurance Analyst to play a pivotal role in the Global System Implementation program in Brazil, deploying JDE (ERP/GL/AP/PO/FA), Kyriba (Treasury), Circulus (AP Automation) and Concur (T&E).

This role will work closely with global teams, local stakeholders, and the external implementation vendor to ensure that local requirements and regulatory needs are accurately captured, designed, tested, and delivered in alignment with the global template and program standards.

The person in this role will act as the main link between Brazil’s business and finance teams and the vendor, making sure local needs are clearly understood and correctly implemented. Strong knowledge of Accounting and Finance, experience with financial system implementations, and solid QA skills are essential.

How you'll make an impact

  1. Solution Design
    • Lead, collect and document business requirements with Accounting (General Ledger, Chart of Accounts), Finance, Fixed Assets, Accounts Receivable, Trade and Non-Trade Accounts Payable, Procurement, Treasury Management (Kyriba), Tax, Master Data, Travel & Expense (Concur), Operations, and other business areas. Translate needs into clear business requirements, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.
    • Support solution design sessions with the vendor and global teams.
    • Perform fit-gap analysis against the global template (JDE, Kyriba, Circulus, Concur), proposing viable localization designs for Brazil.
    • Create process maps (as-is / to-be) and help define internal controls.
    • Support data related activities such as mapping, validation, and master data definitions.
  2. Quality Assurance & Testing Leadership
    • Create and maintain the testing plan including functional, integration, regression, and UAT.
    • Write or review test cases and ensure all requirements have clear acceptance criteria.
    • Track and manage defects, helping teams resolve issues quickly.
    • Organize and support User Acceptance Testing with business users.
    • Document test results and prepare materials for go live readiness.
  3. Change Management, Training & Adoption
    • Support change impact assessments, stakeholder communications, and training (materials, playbooks).
    • Prepare training materials and help run training sessions when needed.
    • Work with teams to ensure successful adoption of the new tools and processes.
  4. Brazil Localization, Controls & Compliance
    • Ensure system design meets Brazilian accounting, tax and regulatory requirements (e.g., SPED ECD/ECF, withholding taxes, ICMS / ISS / IOF / PIS / COFINS, CNAB banking files), aligning with global accounting policies (IFRS/US GAAP) and internal control frameworks (SOX, Segregation of Duties).
    • Review impacts on financial close, reconciliations, tax calculations and audit requirements.
    • Validate rules related to taxes, reporting, electronic documents, and other local obligations.
  5. Data, Integration & Banking Connectivity
    • Work with the vendor and IT teams to define and validate integration interfaces across systems (JDE, Kyriba, Circulus, Concur, Tax/Invoice Vendor, Payroll).
    • Support data migration activities, including data preparation, testing and reconciliation.
    • Assist in designing and validating bank connections, payment files and statement imports.
    • Support environment setup and infrastructure configuration, including validation of system environments, connectivity and technical readiness.
    • Test and validate user access, roles and permissions across JDE, Kyriba, Circulus, Concur and integrated systems.
    • Coordinate and test connectivity and integration flows with the Corporate JDE environment and other global platforms.
    • Work with IT teams to troubleshoot environment issues, interface failures, access problems and technical dependencies.
  6. Vendor & Stakeholder Management
    • Work closely with the implementation partner, reviewing deliverables and tracking progress.
    • Monitor open issues, follow up on deadlines and help manage scope changes.
    • Ensure the vendor understands local needs and delivers solutions that work for Brazil.
    • Communicate risks and problems early to avoid delays.
    • Align global, regional (LatAm) and local stakeholders through clear status reporting, demos and decision logs.
  7. Delivery Methodology & Governance
    • Work within Agile/Hybrid delivery (backlog management, sprint planning, demos/retros, release readiness).
    • Maintain rigorous project documentation (requirements, configurations, test evidence, SOPs), ensuring auditability and knowledge transfer.
    • Support cutover planning, go live preparation and hypercare after deployment.

About you

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business, Information Systems or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or QA Analyst.
  • Solid grounding in Accounting/Finance processes (period close, accruals, reconciliations, AP/AR, T&E), with understanding of IFRS/US GAAP; Brazil statutory/tax familiarity is essential.
  • Proven experience implementing systems such as JDE, Kyriba, Concur or AP automation tools.
  • Experience with integrations, data migration and banking processes.
  • Understanding of Brazilian tax and accounting rules is required.
  • Experience in insurance/brokerage accounting and operations is a strong plus.
  • Knowledge of Agile / Hybrid methods and tools (Azure DevOps, etc.).
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work with global teams in different time zones.
  • Languages: English – mandatory; Portuguese – mandatory; Spanish – fluent is a strong advantage.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally (US and Latin American region).
  • Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid).

  • Opção de convênios médico e odontológico com desconto em folha de pagamento;
  • Apoio à saúde mental e física através das parcerias com a Uniser do Vale e DDF Fitness;
  • Formação continuada através de ações internas promovidas pela escola;
  • Subsídio para realização de cursos relacionados à sua atuação;
  • Programa de descontos e bolsas de estudo para até três filhos nas unidades Moppe;
  • Espaço de descanso aos colaboradores com estrutura ao ar livre e redário.

Esta é a nossa plataforma de banco de talentos e gestão de vagas e recrutamento, que nos auxilia na busca por candidatos alinhados com nossa cultura e perfil.

Aqui você pode se cadastrar para participar dos processos seletivos.

E isso só é possível graças à dedicação de nossos colaboradores, chamados carinhosamente de "moppeanos", que têm uma paixão genuína por educação.

É assim desde o início. Seguimos norteados em ser uma escola de vanguarda e carregamos esse diferencial até mesmo em nosso nome, Moderna Orientação Psicopedagógica (Moppe).

Fomos criados em 1982, a partir de um sonho da Teresinha, nossa diretora. Ela tinha o desejo de construir uma escola diferente de tudo o que se praticava na época, uma escola que formasse alunos muito além do conteúdo e isso só foi possível com o encontro de outras pessoas que compartilhavam deste mesmo ideal.

É por esses e outros motivos que nos orgulhamos de oferecer a base mais forte aos nossos alunos.

E para construirmos essa base forte, contamos com processos de seleção de excelência, diversas estratégias e tecnologias, a fim de encontrar as pessoas certas para ajudar em nossa missão.

Aqui na Moppe você vai encontrar um ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico, afetivo, com uma história e missão valorosa. E saiba que aqui o foco está na parceria, pois independente da área de atuação na escola, buscamos pessoas criativas e movidas pela paixão em aprender, construir e melhorar continuamente aquilo pelo que forem responsáveis.

  • Maintain and apply operational models and KPIs for law enforcement engagement, incorporating industry best practices to enhance service delivery.
  • Serve as a primary contact for sensitive investigations, government requests, and high-impact incidents, offering expert operational support to facilitate timely resolution.
  • Support the deployment and continuous improvement of law enforcement engagement platforms (e.g., LERT), emphasizing efficiency, traceability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Facilitate technology-enabled cooperation through frameworks, institutional agreements, and training programs that enhance interactions with law enforcement and judicial partners.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Compliance teams to assess and mitigate legal, regulatory, and reputational risks related to public safety and law enforcement interactions, particularly in the context of rides and deliveries.
  • Monitor and analyze public safety and law enforcement trends affecting the ride-hailing and food delivery sectors, focusing on privacy, data access, and public safety.
  • Work cross-functionally with global and regional teams, including Government Affairs, Legal, Security, Public Policy, Privacy, Online Safety, Engineering to support comprehensive public safety partnerships and initiatives.
  • Prepare and deliver operational reports and insights to local leadership, highlighting key developments and areas for improvement.
  • Uphold the highest standards of ethics, confidentiality, and data protection in all engagements with law enforcement and judicial authorities.

  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.
  • Executive presence and high-impact communication.
  • Data-driven decision-making and operational excellence.
  • Cross-functional communication.
  • High ethical standards and strong compliance mindset.

title: CONSULTOR DE VENDAS | MÁQUINAS AGRÍCOLAS HORSCH | SANTANA DO ARAGUAIA
description:
O Consultor de Vendas de Máquinas Agrícolas atua como o principal elo entre o cliente e a AVANTHY AGRO, sendo responsável por apresentar, vender e entregar soluções em tecnologia agrícola, desde equipamentos de preparo de solo, semeadura ou plantio, até sistemas de plantio de precisão e equipamentos de aplicação. Ele identifica oportunidades, orienta sobre os diferenciais técnicos da HORSCH (como inovação, precisão, sustentabilidade) e acompanha o cliente durante todo o ciclo da negociação, entrega e pós-venda.

Objetivo do Cargo

Promover o aumento da receita e da participação de mercado da AVANTHY AGRO na região/região-designada, por meio da venda consultiva de máquinas e soluções agrícolas, assegurando alto nível de satisfação dos clientes, forte fidelização e a imagem de inovação que caracteriza a marca.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção e Identificação de Oportunidades
    • Realizar visitas a produtores, fazendas, cooperativas e revendas para compreender suas necessidades agrícolas, área de plantio, tipo de solo e culturas.
    • Apresentar o portfólio de equipamentos e soluções HORSCH — por exemplo, preparadores de solo, semeadoras de precisão e sistemas digitais de agricultura de precisão.
    • Construir pipeline de vendas, qualificar potenciais clientes e estimular demonstrações em campo das máquinas HORSCH.
  • Apresentação Técnica e Proposta Comercial
    • Elaborar e apresentar propostas de valor com base em benefícios técnicos (produtividade, economia de insumos, precisão operacional, sustentabilidade), adaptadas à realidade de cada cliente.
    • Organizar demonstrações de máquinas ou visitas em campo (ou com parceiros), apoiando o cliente na visualização da aplicação prática.
    • Negociar termos comerciais, prazos, financiamento e condições de entrega, alinhando com políticas da HORSCH.
  • Fechamento e Entrega da Solução
    • Acompanhar o processo de pedido até a entrega, garantindo que todas as especificações técnicas e logísticas sejam cumpridas.
    • Coordenar com o departamento de logística, peças e pós-venda para assegurar que a máquina seja entregue com treinamento e suporte técnico ao cliente, conforme padrão HORSCH (qualidade, rastreabilidade, sustentabilidade).
    • Realizar o onboarding do cliente à solução entregue, explicando funcionamento, manutenção preventiva, acesso ao serviço pós-venda e conectividade digital se aplicável (ex.: telemetria, agricultura de precisão).
  • Pós-venda, Relacionamento e Fidelização
    • Manter relacionamento contínuo com o cliente após a entrega: visitas, monitoramento da performance da máquina, suporte técnico ou contato com revendas parceiras.
    • Identificar oportunidades de upsell ou cross-sell de serviços, peças, acessórios ou soluções digitais adicionais que complementem o equipamento HORSCH.
    • Coletar feedback dos clientes para reportar ao time de produto/marketing e contribuir com melhorias ou novas configurações adaptadas ao agricultor brasileiro/latino-americano.
  • Gestão e Reporte de Indicadores
    • Acompanhar e reportar métricas de vendas (volume de máquinas vendidas, taxa de conversão, tempo de ciclo, ticket médio, participação de mercado) e de satisfação do cliente.
    • Manter o CRM atualizado com todas as interações, propostas, follow-ups e status da negociação.
    • Contribuir para o planejamento comercial, previsão de vendas, ações de marketing regional e eventos de demonstração de campo.

Requisitos e Qualificações

Escolaridade

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Desejável curso técnico ou superior em Agronomia, Engenharia Agrícola, Administração ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência

  • Experiência em vendas técnicas ou consultivas, preferencialmente no setor de máquinas agrícolas, implementos ou tecnologia para o agronegócio.
  • Desejável vivência com sistemas CRM, apresentação em campo/feiras e negociação com produtores rurais.

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Conhecimento básico/intermediário de máquinas agrícolas, operações de preparo de solo, semeadura/plantio ou aplicação de proteção de cultivos — alinhado com o portfólio HORSCH.
  • Noções de financiamento agrícola, modelos de negócio de máquinas e serviços de pós-venda.
  • Capacidade de demonstrar benefícios técnicos e econômicos da solução ao cliente (produtividade, custo operacional, precisão, sustentabilidade).

Habilidades Comportamentais

  • Comunicação clara, foco no cliente, empatia e habilidade para traduzir termos técnicos em linguagem acessível ao produtor.
  • Alta orientação para resultados, proatividade e persistência em negociação.
  • Organização, autonomia para gerir seu pipeline e disciplina para seguir processos internos.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, interagir com pós-venda, logística, produto e marketing.

title: Manager, Field Site LN_FR
description:
RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

La tâche principale du/de la directeur(trice) de site de terrain est de faciliter la programmation humanitaire sur un site de terrain spécifique, conformément à la conception du programme, au budget et au calendrier. Le/la directeur(trice) de site de terrain permet la mise en œuvre du programme et soutient les fonctions des programmes, de la logistique, des finances et de l'administration sur le site de terrain. Le/la directeur(trice) de site de terrain est le/la représentant(e) de la mission d’IMC sur un site terrain particulier.

Pour mener à bien ce travail, une personne doit être capable de remplir chaque fonction essentielle avec ou sans aménagements raisonnables.

PRINCIPALES TÂCHES ET RESPONSABILITÉS

Gestion des programmes

  • Contrôler la programmation en collaboration avec les responsables des départements techniques afin d'assurer une mise en œuvre rapide et efficace, conformément aux principes humanitaires, aux règles et réglementations d'IMC et aux exigences des donateurs dans la région.
  • Promouvoir un leadership positif au sein du site de terrain par le biais de réunions de coordination interne régulières et efficaces.
  • Gérer les activités de programmation pour la mise en œuvre en temps voulu de toutes les activités énumérées dans la proposition.
  • Assister les équipes dans l'élaboration et l'exécution des plans de travail.
  • Suivre les dépenses mensuelles et prévoir celles à venir en fonction des activités mises en œuvre sur les sites de terrain.
  • Coordonner les activités avec les agences de mise en œuvre dans la région afin d'éviter les doubles emplois et de combler les lacunes dans les services.
  • Informer régulièrement le bureau de pays de l'avancement des programmes, conformément au protocole, le cas échéant.
  • Avec le soutien de l'équipe MEAL du pays, veiller à ce que des systèmes de suivi et d'évaluation soient en place pour assurer l'efficacité des rapports sur le programme, en vue d'une utilisation conjointe avec le personnel du programme.
  • Veiller à la disponibilité d'informations actualisées sur la communauté affectée ciblée et coordonner les listes et numéros de bénéficiaire avec les différentes parties prenantes.
  • Veiller à ce que la mise en œuvre du programme respecte les délais, les objectifs et le budget, en utilisant les systèmes de S&E disponibles pour atteindre l'impact souhaité.
  • Veiller à ce que les données du programme soient régulièrement mises à jour.
  • Travailler avec le personnel pour soumettre des données et des rapports de qualité élevée, en temps opportun.

Gestion des ressources humaines et renforcement des capacités

  • Créer et maintenir un environnement de travail fondé sur le respect mutuel, au sein duquel les membres de l'équipe s'efforcent d'atteindre l'excellence.
  • Le cas échéant, superviser les actions logistiques et administratives des programmes sur le site de terrain.
  • Promouvoir la redevabilité, communiquer les attentes et fournir un retour d'information constructif par le biais d'évaluations des performances régulières.
  • Soutenir les ressources humaines du bureau de pays lors du recrutement et de l'orientation des nouveaux membres de l'équipe, le cas échéant, en collaboration avec la direction du programme.
  • Promouvoir une compréhension commune des règles et règlements d'IMC par le biais d'une formation continue du personnel.
  • Aider à développer les capacités du personnel et exécuter/suivre la mise en œuvre du plan.
  • Contribuer aux efforts de renforcement de l'équipe pays, aider les membres de l'équipe à identifier les options de résolution des problèmes et assurer l'intégration de tous les membres de l'équipe dans les processus décisionnels pertinents.

Suivi, évaluation, redevabilité et apprentissage

  • Intégrer les approches et activités MEAL dans les plans et opérations du programme, en décrivant comment MEAL sera mis en œuvre à chaque étape du cycle du programme.
  • Soutenir l'équipe MEAL du pays dans la mise en place du système MEAL, des outils de collecte de données et d'un mécanisme formel afin de recueillir, suivre, traiter et agir sur les retours d'information et les plaintes des communautés.
  • Veiller à ce que l'ensemble du personnel et des bénévoles reçoivent une formation de base en matière de communication et de traitement des plaintes.
  • Veiller à ce que son personnel sache comment recevoir, enregistrer et transmettre (au CBFRM) les retours d’information et les plaintes, s’il est contacté par un membre de la communauté.
  • S'assurer que son personnel sait comment donner un consentement éclairé de base (en expliquant ce qu'il advient des retours d'information/plaintes, le calendrier, les différentes façons de contacter IMC, comment/quand recevoir une réponse d’IMC, les droits/limites concernant les plaintes anonymes, etc.).
  • Sur la base des résultats, des enseignements, des retours d'information et des données d'évaluation générés par le système MEAL, identifier et utiliser les meilleures approches pour fournir aux communautés des activités et des informations pertinentes et exploitables en matière de préservation et amélioration des conditions de vie.

Sécurité

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de gestion de la sécurité et le/la DP pour garantir l'élaboration de procédures opérationnelles standard pour les zones d'opérations des sites de terrain. Aider à la révision des plans de sécurité.
  • Veiller à ce que le personnel connaisse les procédures opérationnelles standard et soit en mesure de les suivre.
  • Comprendre et surveiller les changements dans l'environnement et alerter les directeur(trice)s de la sécurité.
  • Développer un réseau pour obtenir des informations pertinentes en matière de sécurité. Développer de bons contacts pour vérifier les changements contextuels.

Représentation

  • Promouvoir le travail d’IMC et assurer la liaison avec les parties prenantes externes concernées, les dirigeants locaux et les représentants du gouvernement.
  • Générer une image positive d'IMC et de son personnel sur le site de terrain.
  • Représenter IMC auprès des Nations unies et de la communauté des ONG et établir des partenariats de collaboration avec les partenaires des ONG, les bénéficiaires de subventions et les autres parties prenantes.

Effectuer les autres tâches qui lui sont confiées. Les fonctions et responsabilités énumérées dans le présent document sont représentatives de la nature et du volume du travail assigné et ne sont pas nécessairement exhaustives.

Qualifications Minimales

  • Généralement, une licence dans un domaine connexe est souhaitée. Une combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience pertinentes peut être acceptée, le cas échéant.
  • Généralement, 5 ans ou plus d'expérience pertinente et progressive dans la gestion de projets et de personnel d'ONG dans des contextes humanitaires ou de développement, dont au moins 2 ans d'expérience internationale dans un rôle de gestion des opérations.
  • Expérience en gestion de projets dans le secteur humanitaire.
  • Connaissance des opérations humanitaires internationales, des structures de coordination et des mandats des donateurs, des agences des Nations unies et d'autres ONG.
  • Bonne compréhension de la gestion financière et de la planification stratégique.
  • Compréhension et capacité à travailler dans un environnement instable et multiculturel (sensibilité culturelle).
  • Profonde sensibilité interculturelle et compréhension des questions de soins de santé.
  • Capacité à faire preuve de discernement et à prendre des décisions de manière indépendante, extrêmement flexible et capable de faire face à des situations stressantes et à des frustrations.
  • Capacité à établir des relations avec le personnel et à le motiver avec efficacité.
  • Créativité et capacité à travailler avec des ressources limitées.
  • Excellentes aptitudes à la prise de décision, esprit d'équipe et solides compétences en matière de communication, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit.
  • Maîtrise des applications informatiques, en particulier MS Word et MS Excel, MS PowerPoint.

Job Summary

The Field Site Manager’s primary duty is to facilitate humanitarian programming at a specific field site location according to program design, budget and timeline. The Field Site Manager enables program implementation and supports the functions of programs, logistics, finance, and administration at the field site location. The Field Site Manager is the representative of the IMC mission in that particular field location.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function with or without reasonable accommodation.

Main Tasks And Responsibilities

Program Management

  • Monitor programming in collaboration with technical departments leads to assure timely and efficient implementation in accordance with humanitarian principles, IMC rules and regulations and donor requirements in the area.
  • Promote positive leadership within field site through regular and efficient internal coordination meetings.
  • Manage programming activities for timely implementation of all activities listed in the proposal.
  • Assist teams in the development and execution of work plans.
  • Track monthly expenditure and project future expenses in reference to activities being implemented at field sites
  • Coordinate activities with implementing agencies in the area to avoid duplication and to address gaps in service.
  • Regularly update country office on progression of programs as per protocol When applicable:
  • With support from the country MEAL team, ensure monitoring and evaluation systems are in place for effective program reporting, for use in coordination with program staff.
  • Ensure availability of up-to-date information on the affected and targeted community and coordinates beneficiary lists and numbers with different stakeholders.
  • Ensure program implementation is on time, target and budget, using available M&E systems to reach desired impact.
  • Make sure program data is updated on regular basis.
  • Work with staff to submit timely and high-quality data and reports.

Human Resources Management and Capacity Building

  • Create and sustain a work environment of mutual respect where team members strive to achieve excellence.
  • When applicable, oversee logistic and administrative actions of the programs in the field site
  • Promote accountability, communicate expectations and provide constructive feedback via regular performance reviews.
  • Support country office HR on the recruitment and orientation of new team members as necessary in collaboration with program management.
  • Promote shared understanding of IMC rules and regulations through ongoing training for staff.
  • Assist in developing staff capacity and deliver/monitor the implementation of the plan.
  • Contribute to country team-building efforts, help team members identify problem-solving options and ensure the integration of all team members into relevant decision-making processes

Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning

  • Integrate MEAL approaches and activities into program plans and operations, outlining how MEAL will be implemented at each stage of the program cycle.
  • Support country MEAL team in establishing MEAL system, data collection tools, and a formal mechanism to capture, monitor, respond to and act on feedback and complaints from communities.
  • Ensure all staff and volunteers receive basic communication and complaint handling skills training.
  • Ensure their staff know how to receive, record, and refer (to the CBFRM) feedback and complaints should they be approached by a member of the community.
  • Ensure their staff know how to provide basic informed consent (explaining what happens to feedback/complaint, timeline, how they can contact IMC, how/when they should receive a response from IMC, rights/limitations regarding anonymous complaints, etc.).
  • Based on findings, lessons, feedback and assessment data generated from MEAL system, identify and utilize the best approaches to provide communities with relevant and actionable life-saving and life-enhancing activities and information.

Security

  • Work closely with Security Management Teams and CD to ensure that Standard Operating Procedures are developed for the field site areas of operations. Assist in the revision of security plans.
  • Ensure staffs are aware of and are able to follow standard operation procedures.
  • Understand and monitor changes in the surroundings and alert security managers to changes.
  • Develop a network to get relevant security information. Develop good contacts to cross check contextual changes.

Representation

  • Promote IMC’s work and liaise with relevant external stakeholders, local leaders and government officials.
  • Generate a positive image of IMC and its personnel in the field site location
  • Represent IMC to UN and INGO community and build collaborative partnerships with NGO partners, sub-grantees, another stakeholder.

Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed in this document are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and not necessarily all inclusive.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Typically, a bachelor's degree in a related field is preferred. An equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be substituted as appropriate.
  • Typically, 5+ years of relevant and progressive NGO project and personnel management experience in humanitarian or development contexts, including a minimum of 2 years of international work experience in an operations management role
  • Experience in project management in the humanitarian sector
  • Familiarity with international humanitarian operations, coordination structures, and the mandates of donors, UN agencies, and other NGOs
  • Good understanding of financial management and strategic planning
  • Understanding and ability to work in unstable and multi-cultural environment (cultural sensitivity)
  • Profound cross-cultural awareness and insight into health care issues,
  • Ability to, exercise sound judgment and make decisions independently, extremely flexible, and could cope with stressful situations and frustrations
  • Ability to relate to and motivate staff effectively
  • Creativity and the ability to work with limited resources
  • Excellent decision-making skills, Team player and strong communication skills, both oral and written.
  • Proficient in computer applications, especially with MS Word and MS Excel, MS PowerPoint

Descrição da vaga

Educar é um ato de responsabilidade moral e social. Junte-se a nós nesta jornada transformadora!

Em 2023, nasceu a APG GOV, que tem como missão transformar lives na Rede Pública Brasileira - a partir de um sonho audacioso: aplicar um modelo de gestão que apoiasse o diretor pedagógico e alavancar a inovação - junto a um compromisso profundo com o desenvolvimento individual e coletivo.

CONHEÇA NOSSA HISTÓRIA

A Rede de Ensino APOGEU foi fundada no ano 2000, por três jovens empreendedores e ex-alunos do Instituto Tecnológico da Aeronáutica (ITA).

Ao longo do tempo, a instituição vem realizando, com êxito, o seu propósito: já são mais de 4.600 aprovações históricas em universidades públicas de todo o país.

E, em 2023, nasceu a APG GOV: que tem como missão transformar lives na Rede Pública Brasileira – a partir de um sonho audacioso: aplicar um modelo de gestão que apoiasse o diretor pedagógico e alavancar a inovação – junto a um compromisso profundo com o desenvolvimento individual e coletivo.

Estamos dedicados a proporcionar uma operação excepcional que prepara os alunos não apenas para sucesso acadêmico, mas também para uma vida de contribuição significativa para a sociedade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

A Nutricionista é responsável pelo monitoramento técnico nutricional nas instituições de ensino, tendo como foco a oferta diária de alimentos saudáveis, adequados e seguros, do ponto de vista higiênico sanitário, resultando em menor desperdício e atendendo às necessidades nutricionais dos escolares durante o período letivo, de forma a contribuir para o crescimento e o desenvolvimento biopsicossocial, aprendizagem, rendimento escolar e formação de práticas alimentares saudáveis.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Utilizar ferramentas e mecanismos de monitoramento técnico nutricional na instituição de ensino, tendo como foco a oferta diária de alimentos saudáveis, adequados e seguros, do ponto de vista higiênico sanitário, resultando em menor desperdício e atendendo às necessidades nutricionais dos escolares durante o período letivo, de forma a contribuir para o crescimento e o desenvolvimento biopsicossocial, aprendizagem, rendimento escolar e formação de práticas alimentares saudáveis;
  • Observar as normativas federais do Programa Nacional de Alimentação Escolar - PNAE, as instruções normativas vigentes do Instituto Fundepar e do Conselho Federal de Nutricionista;
  • Atender ao Descrito no ANEXO I.I Alimentação Escolar do Edital de Chamamento Público SEED/PR Nº 17/2024.

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Formação acadêmica completa em Nutrição;
  • Inscrita e regularizada junto ao Conselho Regional de Nutricionistas da 8ª Região.

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Planejamento de Compras e Gestão Orçamentária – Capacidade de calcular a demanda de alimentos e administrar o orçamento público ou escolar de forma eficiente;
  • Gestão de Estoque e Controle de Qualidade – Experiência no controle de insumos, monitoramento de validade dos alimentos, armazenamento adequado e redução de desperdícios;
  • Habilidade de Comunicação – Facilidade para interagir com a equipe da cozinha, gestores escolares, estudantes e responsáveis, garantindo alinhamento e efetividade na execução das ações nutricionais;
  • Compromisso com a Educação Alimentar – Atuação ativa na conscientização da comunidade escolar sobre a importância de uma alimentação saudável e equilibrada;
  • Conhecimento básico em informática – especialmente para preenchimento de relatórios e acompanhamento de sistemas de gestão.

Informações adicionais

title: ENFERMEIRO-UPA
description:
As UPAs - Unidades de Pronto Atendimento são definidas como estabelecimentos de saúde de complexidade intermediária entre as Unidades Básicas de Saúde/Estratégia Saúde da Família (UBS/ESF) e a Rede Hospitalar, devendo compor, junto com estas, uma rede organizada de atenção às urgências, em conformidade com as diretrizes da Política Nacional de Atenção às Urgências.

As UPAs funcionam 24 horas e prestam atendimento médico de urgência e emergência, adulto e pediátrico, com a possibilidade de inserção de outras especialidades médicas como Ortopedia conforme a necessidade da região.

O atendimento é feito a partir do Acolhimento com Classificação de Risco, que estabelece as prioridades de tempo para o atendimento médico conforme a gravidade do paciente. Além disso, o serviço oferece leitos para observação, realização de procedimentos como exames laboratoriais de urgência, exames de imagem, suturas, inalação, administração de medicamentos e, caso necessário, encaminha os pacientes de maior gravidade, após estabilização, ao Hospital de Referência.

description:

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Specialist Operations to join our Supply Chain team, with strong analytical and project management skills, solid experience in operational planning, exception handling, and continuous improvement. This professional will be responsible for ensuring that workforce, equipment, and infrastructure are strategically dimensioned and continuously optimized to meet operational volumes with quality, agility, and cost efficiency. The role also involves leading data-driven initiatives, conducting time and motion studies, and driving process improvements through accurate analysis and collaboration with multiple departments.

Responsibilities

The Senior Specialist Operations will develop and monitor short-, medium-, and long-term capacity and workforce planning for in-house operations, analyze and allocate resources based on demand and performance, and ensure that operational KPIs such as efficiency, SLA, absenteeism, and UPH are continuously tracked and improved. This person will lead exception handling routines, identify root causes, and implement preventive actions to stabilize processes.

The role includes managing and executing continuous improvement projects focused on productivity, efficiency, and cost reduction, performing time and motion analysis to establish standard times, eliminate waste, and improve process flow. The professional will generate and interpret analytical reports and dashboards using BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI, ensuring data accuracy and visibility for decision-making.

Collaboration with global and local teams is essential to align planning strategies, forecast volumes, and validate supplier capacity. The position also requires preparation of performance reports and the ability to present insights and recommendations to senior management.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in Operational Planning, Exception Handling, and Process Improvement within logistics or e-commerce operations.
  • Strong knowledge of S&OP and S&OE processes, fluent English for daily interaction with international stakeholders.
  • Advanced analytical and communication skills, and solid experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other data analysis tools.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with WMS systems and warehouse operations.
  • Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills.
  • Knowledge of Lean or Six Sigma methodologies.
  • Experience managing projects using structured frameworks and KPIs.
  • Familiarity with process mapping and automation tools.
  • Prior experience conducting time and motion studies or labor standardization initiatives.

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. 1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.

We're looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team

Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming)
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services)
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses — to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Role Overview:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!

What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

title: Cortex Cloud Sales Specialist
description:
Overview

Our Mission: At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are: In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

The Team

Sales - The Sales team at Palo Alto Networks is a pivotal group of professionals dedicated to driving the company\'s growth and market leadership. This team is responsible for selling our comprehensive cybersecurity portfolio, including next-generation firewalls, cloud security, and endpoint protection, to a diverse range of customers, from small businesses to the world\'s largest enterprises. They build and maintain strong relationships with clients, understand their unique security challenges, and architect solutions that protect their digital way of life. Our sales organization is a dynamic, fast-paced environment where strategic thinking, deep product knowledge, and a passion for solving complex problems are paramount. The team works collaboratively with systems engineers, channel partners, and other internal stakeholders to deliver exceptional value and ensure customer success. We are looking for driven, results-oriented individuals who are eager to make an impact in the rapidly evolving world of cybersecurity.

Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Sales Specialist to drive the growth of our Cortex and Cloud business. The ideal candidate will operate in a high-growth environment, have a solid background in cybersecurity sales, and a deep understanding of security solutions. This role requires a strategic thinker who excels in collaboration, engages effectively with customers, and drives revenue growth through the sale of complex solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and cultivate strong customer relationships to drive business growth within the assigned region.
  • Proactively collaborate with the core sales team to align customer strategies and engagements with Cortex and Cloud business objectives.
  • Take full ownership of leading strategic sales campaigns and sales forecasting, utilizing in-depth knowledge of complex sales cycles.
  • Translate complex technical cybersecurity solutions into clear business value propositions for customers during deep technical discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including sales engineers, to provide tailored, customer-centric solutions.
  • Partner with Alliances to develop joint strategies that enhance customer engagement and deliver innovative solutions.
  • Travel domestically as needed to meet with customers and support key business initiatives.

Required Qualifications

Qualifications (Additional Job Description)

  • 5+ years of field sales experience focusing on key customer accounts and delivering value to Enterprise or Major-level accounts.
  • Extensive platform selling experience in complex sales with multiple buying centers.
  • Experience selling Cybersecurity, SIEM, EDR, or CNAPP (DevSecOps, CloudOps) solutions.
  • Established trusted relationships with CIOs and CISOs with the ability to influence and drive strategic conversations.
  • Willingness to travel domestically as necessary to meet business needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with channel partners and a deep understanding of a channel-centric go-to-market strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience operating in a continuous adoption, expansion, and upsell sales motion within a matrixed sales organization.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Venha fazer a diferença no maior banco privado da América Latina. Somos a instituição financeira feita com milhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo e acreditamos que a diversidade dos nossos times é fundamental para que possamos construir soluções inovadoras e adequadas para cada um dos nossos clientes. Por isso, estamos em busca de talentos para integrar nosso quadro de itubers (colaboradores do Itaú).

Conheça As Estruturas Que Compõem o Atacado

O Itaú BBA é o maior Corporate & Investment Bank da América Latina. Atendemos investidores institucionais e empresas com faturamento anual acima de R$ 30 milhões. Pela complexidade dos negócios desses clientes, sabemos que nossa atuação deve ser customizada. Temos um portfólio de investimentos em ativos, assessoria em fusões e aquisições, oferta de ações, securitização, derivativos, operações estruturadas, cash management, financiamentos e garantias, entre outros. São soluções desenhadas por uma equipe de especialistas com base no perfil e necessidades de cada empresa.

Em Wealth Management and Services somos responsáveis pela jornada de investimentos dos nossos clientes, olhando desde a gestão de recursos próprios ou de terceiros em Asset Management, Fund of Funds e Kinea, passando pela estruturação e evolução dos nossos produtos e serviços, até o relacionamento com nossos clientes, sejam eles pessoas físicas de alta renda no Private Bank e na assessoria de investimentos Íon, ou clientes institucionais.

A área de Global Markets & Treasury é responsável pela conexão dos nossos clientes com o mercado, viabilizando o acesso deles aos produtos financeiros. Temos a missão de garantir uma oferta competitiva, inovadora e focada nas necessidades das empresas, cultivando o foco na excelência de atendimento e encantamento dos nossos clientes para gerar resultados.

O Que Estamos Buscando

Estamos buscando por pessoas que queiram se desenvolver e aprender constantemente, compartilhando, colaborando, inovando e entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.

Como um futuro Ituber, é importante que você seja colaborativo (aqui a gente vai de turma!) para construir soluções e proporcionar melhoria contínua na jornada dos nossos produtos. Temos oportunidades em diversas áreas do banco de Atacado e precisamos do seu talento para contribuir com a transformação que buscamos.
